ceiling_directive: Prove parameter-preserving #W[1]-hardness in conflict-graph treewidth for computing a specified one- or two-marked coefficient under polynomially bounded positive integer weights, thereby completing the stated separator boundary.
improvement_directive: Complete oeq:fpt-or-hardness by giving a parameter-preserving #W[1]-hardness reduction for one risk-determining marked coefficient with polynomially bounded integer weights. This would convert the current forest-only oracle and XP diagnostic into a genuine complexity boundary for the same WRI/RDIM functional.
critique: The note does not deliver its advertised field-level separator result: neither the claimed fixed-parameter exact-risk algorithm nor the alternative parameterized-hardness boundary is proved. What is proved is an exact risk reduction, rational-output control, a polynomial-time forest oracle, a standard finite-library SDP consequence, and a generic Monte Carlo risk bracket, so exact certified design selection remains confined to forests rather than bounded-treewidth conflict graphs. The framing is largely faithful about this limitation, but the rural-China consumer claim is unsupported by any instantiated graph, rule library, risk comparison, or design calculation. The central external substrate is also cited only at book or article level rather than by exact theorem locations, weakening reproducibility of the SDP, real-algebraic, and concentration components. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
